payload.reason: The evidence provides specific information about the tuning of the probability value (p) in the binomial distribution used for token replacement during data augmentation, indicating a range of values.

claims.text: The probability of replacing a token when using the binomial distribution for data augmentation is tuned over the range from 0.1 to 0.7.
The p value for the binomial distribution is incremented by 0.2 during the tuning process.
